query_results_summary.below_target_note: Candidate pool = 6 (target 10-15). SOC/security-operations-specific queries returned 0 results in IEEE ToE; expansion queries added 18 more unique records of which several were security-core but foundational (pre-2021).

candidates.title: Understanding Cybersecurity Education Gaps in Europe
candidates.evidence_notes: PESTLE + stakeholder survey on education-system factors; policy-level, not a training intervention. Useful for motivation/background. Abstract Verified; TE 2024.

candidates.title: A Study of Cybersecurity Education Using a Present-Test-Practice-Assess Model
candidates.evidence_notes: RCT-style multi-section assignment; pretest as covariate, post-test DV; applied behavioral outcomes; directly comparable Pre/Post design. Abstract Verified; pages 40-45; TE Feb 2022.

candidates.title: Cybersecurity Education in the Age of Artificial Intelligence: A Novel Proactive and Collaborative Learning Paradigm
candidates.evidence_notes: Novel immersive + collaborative learning paradigm for AI-cybersecurity; 'encouraging results' but work ongoing; engagement reported, controlled outcomes not evident from abstract. Abstract Verified; TE 2024.

candidates.title: Blockchain Integration for Practical Cybersecurity Education With Scalable Cyber Infrastructure
candidates.evidence_notes: Hands-on cyber-infrastructure labs with evidence-based learning; evaluation from student surveys (self-report caution per ToE scope). Abstract Verified; TE 2025.

candidates.title: A Systematic Literature Review on Cyber Security Education for Children
candidates.evidence_notes: PRISMA SLR of 412 papers / 44 analyzed; strong methodological transparency; notes literature lacks comparative effectiveness evaluation - useful gap citation for our contribution. Not SOC-specific. Abstract Verified.

candidates.title: Immersive Virtual Environment for Automotive Security Education
candidates.evidence_notes: User studies with statistically significant improvements in knowledge/engagement/self-efficacy; VR platform for sensor attacks; domain-specific (automotive). Abstract Verified; TE 2026.
